translated_text: My little wife, Jei, 19.6.40, I found a job and I want to write to you right away. It's quite possible that you don't get the letters sometimes, 8-12 days: It's very difficult to write now. But again, my dear, stay calm, I'm in a good place, better than you think. I've found many good friends who are really kind. Fulch, I don't know anything because we're not together, but I can say that my time is going well. I'm always thinking of you, my darling. For the move, I think I'll stay in Corrèze. I feel it's for the best, the best place. If it gets worse, go a little further south, but Caisse, good address at the town hall or at Mrs. Mou's. Don't leave Réginaise without reason. Now you know how good it was, then go to Paris. I hope you're in good health, darling. Think of our baby, think of your health and everyone else. I want you, my little one, to be tough friends with me, and you really can stay calm because of that. So far, I haven't heard from you, but that's quite possible because my job doesn't always allow me to write. I hope that in the future I can write to you more often. But stay calm, even if you don't hear from me for three weeks. I adore you and I love you, my little Laci. Madame E. Zweigenthal, home at Liginiac, Corrèze. R. Zweigenthal 1. R. Zweigenthal I. reg. Czechoslovakia [illegible] Nel posta SP 31121
